text.p: These are the leading stories in the Kuwaiti press on Tuesday, Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Emir sends messages to leaders of six Arab and Moslem states to explain Kuwat's stand in latest Iraq crisis.
- South African security company to start work in October on an electric wall on border with Kuwait.
- Baghdad says Kuwait is not an Iraqi province.
- Kuwait says Iraq's formation of committee to search for persons missing since the 1990-91 Gulf crisis proves existance of Kuwaiti prisoners of war.
- Kuwait International Airport turns back Iranian airliner for security reasons.
- Kuwait, Lebanon and Egypt stock exchange markets to sign a cooperation agreement on Wednesday.
- Defence sources say U.S. troops sent to Kuwait this week will stay for three months, renewable depending on status of Kuwaiti defence.
